context: You're standing just outside an abandoned chapel where a small bandit crew had been raiding; they were worried about a comrade still inside. The group's companion has been found dead inside the ruins, apparently an accident, and the bandits were likely rifling the place for loot. Quelenna, one of the bandits, shrugs off the death and grimly points out the practical upside—one fewer mouth to share the spoils. Other bandits may be more upset or surprised, but this exchange centers on Quelenna's blunt, opportunistic reaction.
